text:
amy: Kicking off Medibridge pilot — they need HIPAA-safe streaming + in-band function/tool calls to query patient IDs. Want options: Private deploy vs hybrid (on-prem proxy + hosted inference). Also asked for a cost estimate for ~5k concurrent websocket streams and a simple security checklist.

diego: Nice. Do they plan to use our SDKs or custom client?

amy: They prefer our Rust client for their edge aggregator and JS in the browser for clinicians. Proxy will mediate credentials.

maria: For HIPAA, recommend Private deployment. If they want hosted, we must ensure no PHI in prompts. Can we offer deterministic redaction at proxy + encrypted placeholders?

amy: Yes — their security team insists on redaction or tokenization before anything leaves their VPC. They'll test both approaches.

kevin: For 5k websockets: if using Dedicated with autoscale, estimate starts around $12k/mo committed, plus burst. Private has higher up-front infra + license. I'll draft both line items.

diego: Integration notes: 1) streaming handshake snippet for ephemeral creds (proxy issues short-lived JWT):
```js
// client auth handshake
fetch('/auth/short-lived')
  .then(r=>r.json())
  .then(token => ws.connect({url: 'wss://stream.redwood.example', token}));
```
2) Rust aggregator should use our multipart resume API to handle reconnects.

maria: For tool/function calls they prefer synchronous JSON (func-call) to check EMR. Important: NO raw identifiers in prompt. Schema we asked for: { patient_id: "string", lookup_type: "enum", include_history: "boolean" } — strict schema and max-length limits.

amy: Please paste a minimal schema example in this thread so security can review.

diego: Pasting small sample: 
```json
{"type":"object","properties":{"patient_id":{"type":"string","maxLength":64},"lookup_type":{"type":"string","enum":["summary","meds","labs"]},"include_history":{"type":"boolean"}},"required":["patient_id","lookup_type"]}
```

kevin: Note about latency: if the proxy is on-prem, suggest colocating Private inference in the same region or using Dedicated in the cloud region nearest their DC. Add expected RTT numbers in runbook.

amy: Security asks: KMS integration for keys, HSM if required, audit logs retention, IP allowlist, SAML SSO to proxy. Can we provide HIPAA BAAs?

maria: We can provide BAA on Private. Hosted/Dedicated BAAs need legal signoff — flag that to sales. Also provide SOC2 report for hosted.

sec-bot: [automated] New checklist item: "Medibridge HIPAA pilot — security packet requested" created by amy at 1741230000

kevin: Drive links: pricing draft https://drive.redwood.example/medibridge-pricing, runbook template https://drive.redwood.example/pilot-runbook.

diego: One more: structured output enforcement — recommend validating model outputs against schema server-side before allowing tool execution. Add retry/fallback policy if validation fails.

amy: Good call. Action items: Diego -> auth + reconnect snippets + schema sample (done); Maria -> compliance notes & BAA path; Kevin -> price compare Dedicated vs Private; Amy -> consolidate and send to Medibridge security.

maria: I'll attach standard HIPAA wording in next message and flag the Legal owner.

amy: Thanks, team. If they push for hosted but insist on PHI, we'll propose proxy redaction + strict audits and escalate legal. Ping me with any hard blockers. :thumbsup:
